purpose: Reduce repeated-selection and hidden-shift risk before promoting a learned component to Public
scope: Applied only after a candidate completes all five frozen grouped outer folds

stochastic_repeat.acceptance: Positive mean delta across the two repeated folds and no category drop over 0.005

rationale: Experiment 230 improved five-fold nested validation but degraded on Public.
Experiment 280 changed one adapter, improved locked validation on four of five folds, but tied Public.
A new model family must therefore survive both downstream decision rules and a predeclared stochastic repeat before production promotion.
limitations: This gate reduces known risks but cannot reproduce the hidden product distribution or guarantee a Public improvement.
